Garrett, 2026-10-10: Claude may edit its own tier gate, but must not be able to grade itself -- so the cases that define a correct gate live here, where the narrow permission rule Edit(**/.claude/hooks/tier_gate.py) does not reach. Changing this file goes through the auto-mode classifier or Garrett. Run by tier_gate_golden.py in CI.
